## What were you trying to do?
Describe the research task and the decision this output should support.

## Which step did you use?
- [ ] Apify Actor directly
- [ ] n8n starter
- [ ] AI skill / MCP
- [ ] Saved sample only

## Expected result and actual result
Include the Actor build and n8n version if relevant. Did the run succeed, fail, stop at a limit, or return incomplete content?

## Small reproduction
If safe to share, provide one public URL and a redacted input. Add the relevant coverage flags from RUN_SUMMARY. Do not post tokens, cookies, credentials, customer data, or private logs.

## Where did you find this example? (optional)
This helps us understand which instructions are useful. No review or rating is required.

## What would make you use it again?
Describe a missing field, difficult setup step, or recurring task.
